title: Law to add 311 category for jail conditions
summary: This bill would require the city to create a 311 service request category for complaints about conditions or treatment of people in city jails. People filing a complaint could identify the incarcerated individual, staff involved and facility, and note whether they are the incarcerated person, an advocate, an official or another party. The city would publish a public data set tracking these requests and their status, and the law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
